children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test resistance at $7.38-1/4 per bushel, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $7.47-1/2 to $7.53-1/4 range.
A correction from $7.95 may have completed, as suggested by the five-wave structure of the fall from $7.62-1/2 and a break above a falling trendline.
The contract is expected to bounce toward the peak of the wave iv at $7.43-1/2. However, the upside might be extended to $7.62-1/2, the peak of the bigger wave b.
Support is at $7.23, a break below which could confirm the extension of the downtrend toward $7.13-3/4. On the daily chart, the market seems to have broken a resistance at $7.30.
The break is likely to lead to a gain to $7.51-3/4.
